text:
dina: Quick note 1: bringing up Asteria customer LoRA merge (merge id 412) into staging. Patch uses new adapter_schema (adapter_v3) and token map tcmap3. Running int4 smoke + int8-hybrid as contrast. Posting quickpack results here.

kevin: Thx. Is adapter_v3 backwards-compatible with the loader? Any alias shim needed?

dina: Loader supports adapter_alias flag but adapter_v3 has swapped special tokens (\u2018<amt>\u2019 -> <money>) so token ids shift. No conversion applied yet.

marta: Ran 300-sample quickpack targeting amounts & dates. Results: amount parsing F1 down 2.1% on int4. Example: 
```
input: "Total: $3.25 incl."
baseline: "3.25 USD"
asteria-lo: int4: "325 USD"
```
Looks like the decimal point got absorbed into the integer token in decode.

kevin: Oof. Could be token-id remap or quantized rounding merging '.' with digits token. Try rerun with --no-fast-bpe and with adapter_alias=true.

ci-bot: Canary started for asteria-lo:v1 (canary 7711) - 3k tokens queued. Link: https://ci.redwood/internal/canaries/7711

marta: Re-ran with --no-fast-bpe and adapter_alias=true. Decimal issue mostly gone, F1 recovered ~1.6pts but still some spacing errors ("3.25USD"). Suggest we add a small post-process rule to ensure currency spacing while we fix tokenizer mapping.

dina: Good find. Kevin, can you produce a token-diff between base tok and tcmap3 and propose a minimal alias patch? If alias closes >80% we'll add loader shim; otherwise block canary.

kevin: Will run token_diff now. Command: 
```
python tools/token_diff.py --base models/base_tok.json --new models/tcmap3.json --out /tmp/tokdiff_asteria.csv
```
I'll push a tiny mapping for '.' and common money suffix tokens.

marta: Also recommend rerunning int8-hybrid for sanity. int8-hybrid showed smaller regressions earlier in other customers.

ci-bot: Canary 7711 update: p50 68ms, p95 210ms, errors 0.5% (mostly formatting diffs). Artifact: https://ci.redwood/internal/artifacts/7711

dina: Thanks team. If alias shim + postprocess gets us within threshold, schedule a quant-resweep (gptq group 128->64) and add quickpack_amounts to long-term regressions (asteria-reg-v1). Assign owners: @dina owner, @kevin tokenizer, @marta eval.

kevin: Patch uploaded to staging branch. Will monitor next canary run.

dina: Closing for now; will re-open if further drift appears. :thumbsup:
